class GaloisDetokenizer:
    def detokenize(self, tokens: list[str]) -> str:

        # break reconstruction of strings that contain spaces, so we resolve
        # each token independently to its unique source character instead.

from tokenizer import tokenize

SPACE_TOKEN = "Ġ"


class GaloisDetokenizer:
    """Right adjoint to :func:`tokenizer.tokenize`.

    ``tokenize`` maps every character of the input to a single token: a space
    becomes the GPT-style marker ``"Ġ"`` and every other character is passed
    through unchanged.  The detokenizer inverts exactly that mapping, so that
    the adjunction unit

        tokenize(detokenize(tokenize(s))) == tokenize(s)

    holds for every input string ``s``.
    """

    def detokenize(self, tokens: list[str]) -> str:
        text = "".join(tokens)
        return text.replace(SPACE_TOKEN, " ")

    def reconstruct(self, text: str) -> str:
        """Convenience helper: detokenize(tokenize(text))."""
        return self.detokenize(tokenize(text))

import random
import sys

from detokenizer import UnitCounitDetokenizer
from tokenizer import tokenize

detok = UnitCounitDetokenizer()

cases = [
    "",
    "a",
    "hello world",
    "  leading and trailing  ",
    "Ġ literal in text",
    "xĠy",
    "\t\n mixed whitespace",
    "unicode é😀 ",
    "a b  c   d",
]

alphabet = ["a", "b", " ", "Ġ", "\t", "\n", "é", "😀", ""]
random.seed(1234)
for n in range(0, 30):
    for _ in range(300):
        cases.append("".join(random.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(n)))

failures = []
for text in cases:
    tokens = tokenize(text)
    rebuilt = detok.detokenize(tokens)
    if tokenize(rebuilt) != tokens or rebuilt != text:
        failures.append((text, tokens, rebuilt))

with open("verify_result.txt", "w") as fh:
    if failures:
        fh.write("FAIL\n" + repr(failures[:5]))
        sys.exit(1)
    fh.write("PASS\n")

from tokenizer import tokenize


class AdjunctionDecoder:
    """Detokenizer that is a right adjoint to :func:`tokenizer.tokenize`.

    The tokenizer maps ``" "`` to the GPT style marker token ``"Ġ"`` (and
    otherwise keeps characters as their own tokens).  The detokenizer must
    undo exactly that mapping: every ``"Ġ"`` marker becomes a plain space
    again.  Only the space character is special, so

        tokenize(detokenize(tokenize(s))) == tokenize(s)

    holds for every input string ``s`` (the unit of the adjunction).
    """

    SPACE_MARKER = "Ġ"

    def detokenize(self, tokens: list[str]) -> str:
        if tokens is None:
            return ""
        parts = []
        for token in tokens:
            if token is None:
                continue
            if not isinstance(token, str):
                token = str(token)
            # Tokens may carry the space marker anywhere inside them
            # (e.g. "Ġhello"); restore every occurrence to a real space.
            if self.SPACE_MARKER in token:
                token = token.replace(self.SPACE_MARKER, " ")
            parts.append(token)
        return "".join(parts)

        assert tokenize(decoder.detokenize(toks)) == toks, sample
        assert decoder.detokenize(toks) == sample, sample
    print("adjunction checks passed")
